title: Blood Orange Spritz: frosted product page

techniques.name: Soft focus with type

blur.label: Focus blur
blur.note: Every blur the page lays, the 8 px frost of the glass and the warm washes first, as a multiple of its own. Below 0.7 the pane stops reading as frosted.

frost.label: Frost
frost.note: How white the glass is (its 18% white tint), as a multiple. Below 0.4 the slices read as crisp clip art through it.

ptop.label: Pane line
ptop.note: Where the frosted pane starts: above it the fruit is crisp, below it frosted. Higher frosts more of the fruit.

slices.label: Segments
slices.note: Segments in each citrus round and wedge behind the glass.

wash.label: Warm wash
wash.note: Strength of the two warm orange washes behind the glass, as a multiple of the page’s own.

spark.label: Sparkle size
spark.note: Size of the four-point sparkles on the glass. 0 removes them.

techniques.implementation: A soft field set behind or around crisp type and a single sharp subject. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
